# Lorenzo Fumagalli

> Senior Mobile Engineer & Technical Lead based in Milan, Italy. Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose), Kotlin Multiplatform, mobile architecture. Senior Consultant at Deloitte, leading a team of 3 Android and 5 iOS developers on Calzedonia Group apps (Tezenis, Calzedonia, Intimissimi) used by over 1.5 million users.
